items.text: REPORTED REFERRED TO WAYS AND MEANS
AMEND (T) AND RECOMMIT TO WAYS AND MEANS

items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the public health law, the social services law, the state
finance law and part H of chapter 59 of the laws of 2011, amending the public
health law and other laws relating to known and projected department of health
state fund Medicaid expenditures, in relation to fair pay for home care aides
items.lawCode: Add §3614-f, amd §§3612, 3614-d, 2802, 4403-f & 3614-c, Pub Health L; amd §§365-f & 364-j, Soc Serv L; add §91-h, St Fin L; amd Part H §92, Chap 59 of 2011

A.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the public health law, the state finance law and part H of
chapter 59 of the laws of 2011, amending the public health law and other laws
relating to known and projected department of health state fund Medicaid
expenditures, in relation to fair pay for home care aides
A.lawCode: Add §3614-f, amd §§3614-d & 3614-c, Pub Health L; add §91-h, St Fin L; amd Part H §92, Chap 59 of 2011

summary: Enacts provisions to provide minimum wages for home care aides; requires at least 150% of minimum wage or other set minimum; directs the commissioner of health to set regional minimum rates of reimbursement for home care aides under medicaid and managed care plans.
title: Relates to fair pay for home care aides
